description:
Au sein des équipes de notre client grand compte (agence de stratégie et de transformation marketing) vous serez amené(e)s à accompagner ce dernier sur ses projets de transformation digitale.
Vos missions seront les suivantes:
EXPERTISE
- Organisation & Gestion de projet :

• Être une référence sur la préparation et la gestion opérationnelle, la construction et le suivi régulier de plannings complexes sur la base du devis validé

• Interagir régulièrement avec les Opérations pour la réservation et la planification des ressources (staffing)

• Suivre le brief auprès des experts

• On-boarder la ou les équipes projet et organiser / présenter les kick-offs internes & client o Piloter la production des livrables et leur qualité

• Piloter ce qui a été produit et estimer le reste à produire

• Piloter le scope (périmètre d’engagement) et être capable d’identifier des changements de périmètre ayant un impact sur le planning et /ou sur le budget du client

• Gérer les dépendances et les priorités projet

• Qualifier, estimer et budgétiser les changements de scope intervenant sur les projets

• Suivre et traiter les remontées d’alertes à son management et à son client

• Identifier les risques, alerter et proposer un plan de mitigation

• Contribuer / élaborer certains livrables (spécifications fonctionnelles, rapport / synthèse, etc..)

• Contacter et entretenir la relation avec les partenaires externes o Analyser les KPIs des projets et leurs tendances

- Reporting :

• Préparer et animer les instances de pilotage opérationnelles (worklist, weekly report...)

• Formaliser et diffuser les agendas, comptes-rendus, bilans... (instances de pilotage opérationnelles, réunion de travail interne ou externe...)

• Piloter la rentabilité de ses projets et suivre / agir / alerter si changement de celle-ci (objectif DCM Agence : 60%) et préparer le reporting opérationnel et financier pour la Direction des Opérations et la Direction Financière, maitriser les couts externes (notamment les free-lance)

• Mettre en place les méthodes et les outils de pilotage proposés par l’Agence en les adaptant à la typologie du projet au contexte client

• Reporter régulièrement à ses managers sur l’activité de ses comptes

- Contexte Agile :

• Sur certains projets/clients, peut être amené à jouer un rôle de Scrum Master au sein d’une équipe agile (définition des ways of working, DoR/DoD, mise en place des cérémonies, setup des outils etc.)
- Mettre son expertise au service d’expériences good pour les clients, pour les utilisateurs, pour la société
- Porter l’offre globale de l’Agence auprès de ses clients et/ou prospects, notamment sur les sujets de responsabilité digitale (data privacy, sobriété numérique, accessibilité...)
MANAGEMENT
- Encadrer et soutenir le(s) chef(s) de projet junior et/ou stagiaire, les faire monter en compétences, les amener à plus d’autonomie et de séniorité
- Distribuer les missions, clarifier les rôles et maximiser le potentiel de son équipe
- Participer aux recrutements des stagiaires et juniors de l’Agence et à leurs évaluations annuelles le cas échéant
- Savoir manager des parties prenantes externes
- Exceller dans sa collaboration avec les autres expertises de l’Agence

• Bac+5 web/digital (université, école de commerce)

• Vous avez minimum 3 ans d'expérience sur un poste similaire

• Vous avez déjà encadré/managé une équipe

• Un niveau d'anglais opérationnel est recommandé

title: Working Student B2C SEO & AI Search (x/f/m)

What you’ll do

As a working student in B2C SEO and AI Search, you will support us in the following areas:

• Content SEO, CMS and editing: support content strategies, maintain WordPress content, and optimize copy for patients and search

• Keyword research, competitor analysis, and reporting: analyze the German health market and monitor SEO performance using tools such as Google Search Console and Semrush

• AI search and cross-functional support: explore generative-AI-supported SEO work and collaborate with B2C Marketing and Patient Content

Working with us, you will learn:

• How SEO and AI search are applied in a fast-growing health-tech company

• Practical experience in content optimization, CMS workflows, and SEO analytics

• How to collaborate across local and international marketing teams

Who you are 

If you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You could be our next team mate if you:

• Are studying marketing, media, communications, journalism, business administration, or a similar field, can work up to 20 hours per week during the semester, and have excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Speak German C2 and English C1 level ; French or Italian is a plus

• Are familiar with a CMS such as WordPress and with AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

• Have first experience in SEO or content marketing and with tools such as Google Search Console or Keyword Planner

• Have initial experience with Canva or an interest in translation and generative AI

• Have previous experience in marketing, communications, journalism, editorial work, publishing, or healthcare

What we offer 

• A structured and personalized onboarding program through our Doctolib Academy , as well as a wide range of in-house training opportunities

• A flexible working model that allows for hybrid and office-based work

• A Deutschlandticket sponsored by Doctolib, or reimbursement of your semester ticket

• 28 vacation days per year (calculated pro rata according to your working schedule)

• The opportunity to work from EU countries or the UK for up to 10 days per year (eligible after 6 months)

• Company health insurance with many additional benefits and subsidies (eligible after 6 months)

• Regular breakfast in the office and  subsidies for your lunch or grocery shopping

• A  subsidized sports program with our partner Urban Sports Club

The Interview Process

• First Interview with the Hiring Manager 

• Case study Interview 

Job Details

• Working Student in part-time: up to 20 hours per week 

• Duration: 12 months

• Workplace: Berlin

• Salary: €15 gross/hour - (€16 gross/hour from January 2027)

• Start date:  November 2026

• Hybrid setup with 2 office days per week

 

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g. pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.
 

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Position Summary

Delinea is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the middle of our identity security platform: the inventory of identities and resources, the service that decides when two accounts belong to the same person, and the graph that traces where that person can go. Correlation is the part customers feel most directly, since someone holding six accounts across three clouds should show up once. The same role owns how this data leaves the team, through stable resource identifiers, a change feed, and contracts other products build against. What this layer publishes is what the authorization layer reads when it decides who gets access in the moment. You will work closely with graph engineering, data science, and the product teams that depend on this data.

Key Responsibilities

- Deliver the identity graph and the correlation service that resolve scattered accounts into one person or one AI agent, and answer what that identity can reach.

- Own the inventory and resource explorer that other Delinea products read from, including the coverage and freshness they depend on.

- Settle how effective access is computed and where that computation lives, so a permission granted three different ways through nested groups still means one thing to every consumer reading it.

title: Instructional Designer (start working on June 16, 2025) - WFH
description:
TASQ is looking for an instructional designer for digital learning to start working remotely as soon as June 16, 2025.
The pre-screening interview will be conducted over the phone or Microsoft Teams.
**Experience:**
Proficiency in authoring tools such as PowerPoint, Word, Articulate, and Creative Cloud is essential, along with skills in graphic design and digital audio production. At least 2 years of BPO experience and a portfolio that can be shown related to the BPO instructional designer job would be needed.
Employment Type: Full-time
**Job Overview:**
The Instructional Designer for Digital Learning will develop content across various learning formats, including instructor-led training (ILT), virtual instructor-led training (VILT), and eLearning, with an emphasis on eLearning, microlearning, and learning validation tasks. This role includes creating storyboards for content that will be handed over to Digital Developers for implementation. Additionally, the position supports the Learning Management System for internal training and client requirements. The ideal candidate should have a passion for storytelling and creating engaging user experiences.
**Responsibilities and Duties:**

• Design and create materials, programs, curriculum, and course content for online training, catering to both classroom and self-directed learning environments.

• Utilize authoring tools such as PowerPoint, Word, Articulate 360, Adobe Creative Cloud, and video editing software to develop engaging content for instructor-led training and microlearning modules. Familiarity with Cognota is a plus.

• Develop engaging content for virtual and in-person classroom settings based on supplied materials, ideas, and stakeholder feedback.

• Produce a range of learning deliverables (courses, games, videos, quizzes) that cater to different learning styles and levels of expertise.

• Apply adult learning models, including Agile, ADDIE, and the Dick & Carey Models, to guide the content development process.

• Ensure timely production of materials within budget and in line with the training roadmap.

• Adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

• Collaborate with stakeholders and subject matter experts to identify training needs and deliver high-quality materials.

• Create templates and master files for training resources.

• Develop instructor manuals, rubrics, and other supporting tools for facilitators.

• Understand branding and the technical specifications required for digital outputs.

• Perform additional tasks as assigned by management.

**Required Knowledge and Skills:**

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment and lead discussions to clarify learning needs.

• Strong consulting, communication, and engagement skills with subject matter experts and stakeholders to create training materials that address performance or skills gaps.

• Capability to manage multiple projects concurrently.

• Proven ability to complete the entire training cycle, including needs assessment, planning, development, coordination, monitoring, and evaluation.

• Proficient in technical writing and documentation.

- Excellent organizational skills.

• Strong interpersonal, presentation, and facilitation abilities.

• Familiarity with online, instructor-led, and e-learning software applications.

• Understanding of adult learning theories and best practices in facilitation, training, and blended learning solutions.

title: Founding Account Executive

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

• Prepare regional assessments, state and site reviews, profiles, alerts, and decision-focused briefings.

• Provide research support for site and project evaluations, executive visits, meetings, and business activities in the United States.

• Maintain an up-to-date regional intelligence picture and provide ongoing reporting on material developments affecting the company’s sites and projects in the United States.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

title: Corporate Receptionist

This is a unique opportunity to join a leading proprietary trading firm with an entrepreneurial and innovative culture at the heart of its business. We value quick-witted, creative minds, and challenge them to make full use of their capacities.

As the Corporate Receptionist, you will play an important role in supporting the Office Management team’s mission: establish an exceptional workplace experience. With hospitality and professionalism at the forefront of your mind, you will be responsible for ensuring employees and visitors have access to all the services and amenities we offer in the workplace. We are looking for someone who will bring energy, passion, and a strong work ethic.

This position will start on a temporary basis with the possibility of being hired on a permanent basis.

• Open the office on time and ensure readiness to welcome, greet, and register employees, visitors, vendors, clients, and corporate executives.

• Oversee the reception area and boardroom, ensuring meeting rooms are clean, functional, fully stocked, and properly reset after each meeting.

• Manage meeting-room conflicts, including double bookings, unplanned meetings, and extended reservations.

• Screen incoming calls, direct them to the appropriate contacts, and take messages for timely follow-up.

• Process and log incoming and outgoing mail and courier services accurately and efficiently.

• Assist the Office Manager with business travel coordination and related arrangements.

• Monitor office-supply inventory and place orders as needed.

• 3+ years of experience as a receptionist or administrative support role within a corporate, leisure or hospitality environment

• High degree of professionalism with experience working with high profile clientele

• Very strong interpersonal relationship skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Experience balancing multiple requests and telephone lines

• Punctual, dependable, proactive and anticipatory; quick to meet challenges and think outside the box to formulate solutions

title: Translational AI Scientist/Engineer
description:
BioAge Labs (BIOA) is finding new ways to treat disease by targeting the mechanisms of aging, with the ultimate goal of increasing healthy human lifespan.

We are seeking a scientist/engineer with hands-on expertise in building generative and agentic AI systems and a strong foundation in target discovery, drug discovery and translational science. You will design and deploy AI-enabled systems that take a target and produce decision-grade, evidence-backed recommendations - from mechanism hypotheses to validation design - with every claim grounded in retrievable evidence and every gap stated explicitly, and that assess how likely a human-derived signal is to hold up in the lab and beyond.

This role is ideal for someone who would rather build production AI systems for translational science than only run analyses, and who has enough hands-on biology to know when a recommendation is scientifically sound and when it merely reads well. You will own the engineering of these systems end to end, from retrieval and orchestration to evaluation and deployment, and work as a peer with the scientists who act on their outputs.

What you will do

• Design and deploy agentic AI systems that support scientific reasoning, hypothesis generation and evidence synthesis for the translational questions that follow target identification: mechanism and source of signal, indication selection, experimental design, reagent quality and translatability.

• Build systems that recommend how to test a target - experimental system (in vivo, ex vivo or in vitro), model, indication, endpoints tiered by translational relevance, intervention modality and study parameters - with each choice grounded in published precedent and with an explicit statement when no precedent exists.

• Develop tool-using workflows that retrieve and integrate structured and unstructured evidence - knockout and perturbation phenotypes, endpoint precedent, published effect sizes, tool compound and reagent quality, prior programme outcomes, primary literature - with full provenance.

• Build the cross-species layer: determine whether a target's human signal is reproducible in a model system, and identify the readouts that link experimental results back to the human cohort data.

• Assess translatability: develop evidence that a human-derived signal will reproduce in vivo and onward, calibrated against targets with known preclinical and clinical outcomes, and feed that evidence back into target prioritisation.

• Build the evaluation framework for these systems - reference sets of targets with known experimental outcomes, metrics for citation quality and coverage, and calibration of translatability calls - with attention to scientific reliability and interpretability in decision-critical settings.

• Encode domain rules on the meaning and reliability of each external source, so that absent, weak and contradicting evidence are handled distinctly and never collapsed.

• Partner with target biology and experimental teams so that recommended designs are usable by the people who run the studies, and incorporate their outcomes back into the system.

• Own these systems end to end (architecture, implementation, testing, deployment and monitoring) as maintainable software that scientists rely on day to day, not one-off notebooks or prototypes.

What we expect of you

Basic qualifications

• PhD with 2+ years of relevant experience, or Master's degree with 5+ years, or Bachelor's degree with 7+ years, in computer science, computational biology, biology, translation science or a related field. We welcome scientist-first candidates with demonstrated ability to build production-quality AI workflows, as well as engineer-first candidates with deep translational-biology judgment.

Preferred technical qualifications

• Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-based agentic systems in production or production-like settings: tool use, retrieval over structured and unstructured sources, multi-agent orchest

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Why This Role Exists
Xsolla is going all-in on becoming an AI-first company, and we're not waiting for a slow rollout to get there. We're offering AI Engineer Internships in regions across the globe to help drive that shift directly, not by sitting in the back office, but by building.
You'll work on two things:
Internal AI initiatives - helping unlock AI tooling and integrations across Xsolla faster than our existing teams can alone.
Proof-of-concept builds on our own APIs - showing our product and engineering teams what's possible when you build with AI as a core part of your workflow, not an afterthought.
This isn't a shadow-and-observe internship. You'll ship code that goes to customers - internal teams or external players and game developers - working closely with senior engineers and fellow interns across our global regions.
Who You'll Work With
You won't be isolated on an intern-only project island. You'll work closely with senior engineers who are actively rebuilding how we write software, and you'll be part of a global cohort of interns building in parallel across our regions. That combination is the point: senior engineers give you a bar for what production-grade, customer-facing code looks like, and your fellow interns give you a peer group to trade ideas, code, and AI workflows every week.

Gegidze Group is a holding company built out of Tbilisi since 2017. We build and operate companies across three areas: business services, regulated finance, and real assets. Our bet is that the next generation of global companies will be built from places like Georgia, not in spite of being there, but because of what it offers: low tax, senior talent at a fraction of Western cost, and a position between Europe, Asia and the Middle East. We exist to make that practical for founders, and to prove it by doing it ourselves. Everything we sell to clients, we run first. We build companies to hold, not to flip.

Our companies:

• Gegidze- tax, legal, structuring and financing for founders operating from Georgia.

1000+ clients across 50+ countries.

• Digital Jungle - coworking and office space in Tbilisi.

The role
I take one or two people a year. Not more.

Here is the deal.

I need people who can sell and build. Not one or the other.

Two ways in

1. You have an idea.

Bring it. If it holds up and you can sell, you get capital, legal, finance, developers, and a brand people already pick up the phone for. You run it. You own a real piece of it.

2. You do not have an idea yet.

Also fine. Work next to me on the existing businesses for 6 to 12 months. Learn how we structure, sell, hire and finance things here. Then take one vertical and run it.

What you will actually do

• Sell. Every day. Outbound, partnerships, conferences, deals.

• Open new markets: UK, DACH, Nordics, Benelux, Middle East, US.

• Build what you sold.

• Hire the team that delivers it.

• Own the P&L.

What I am looking for

• You have carried a number and hit it.

• You have closed B2B deals yourself, not managed someone who did.

• You move without being told twice.

• You can write a clear email and hold a room with a founder.

• Fluent English. German, Russian or a Nordic language is a real advantage.

What I am not looking for

• Consultants who make decks.

• People who need a job description to know what to do today.

• Anyone who wants to learn entrepreneurship without selling anything.

• Title collectors.

What you get

• [BASE] plus commission on everything you close.

• Equity in the business you build or run.

• The whole group behind you: capital, licences, talent, legal, clients.

• Me, directly. No manager in between.

This is not a safe job. It is the fastest route I know from operator to owner.

If that is you

Message me with two things:

1. The hardest deal you ever closed.

No CV needed. A paragraph is enough.

Valerian Gegidze

Founder, Gegidze Group

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.

As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:

- Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.

- Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.

- Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.

HexCoded is an AI video studio: you should be able to make anything you can imagine. We are a very small team in Gurgaon building the tools that are reshaping how video, image and audio get made.
What you'll actually work on

•
Growth and GTM. Run outbound and paid experiments end to end - build the list, write the copy, send it, read the numbers, kill what does not work. You will own campaigns, not assist on them.

The numbers. Own the funnel from signup to first paid render. Find where people fall out, tell us why, and be specific enough that we can go fix it.

•
Users. Talk to them - on calls, on chat, in their own words. Bring back what they actually said, not a summary of what we hoped they said.

•
Product. Break things before customers do. Test what is about to ship, write the bug that gets fixed, and argue for the change you think matters.

•
Market. Know every tool in our space better than its own marketing page does - what it costs, what it does better than us, and where we win.

•
Whatever is on fire. Some weeks that is a vendor, a spreadsheet, a hiring pipeline or a launch. This is the honest part of the job.

What you'll bring

•
You are already an AI generalist , whether or not you have called it that. You use these tools daily, you know which one to reach for and where each falls over, and you have built something with them that you were not qualified to build. High agency. You close loops without being chased. Given a half-formed problem and no instructions, you come back with it handled - or with the one question that was actually blocking you.

•
Comfort with numbers. Spreadsheets do not scare you, and neither does being wrong in public when the data says so.

•
Clear, short writing. Most of your output is words other people act on. Long and vague is worse than short and wrong.

•
Speed over polish. You would rather ship ten rough things this week than one perfect thing next month.

• Final-year student or a 2026 graduate. Any degree.

How to apply

• Apply through this posting - it takes two minutes, and we read every one.

The Opportunity
As a Data Engineer at LendingTree , you’ll build the pipelines, models, and data services behind reporting, analytics, and data science across our lending and insurance businesses. You’ll tackle complex integration and modeling challenges, improve reliability and cost efficiency, and apply practical AI tools to help the team deliver better data solutions faster.
How You’ll Make an Impact

• Build and operate scalable batch and real-time streaming pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, and database applications across multiple lines of business, with clear plans for schema changes, retries, and recovery.

• Design dimensional models and reusable datasets for business, analytics, and data science needs. Perform complex data analysis to validate business rules, identify trends and anomalies, and uncover opportunities.

• Own the reliability and efficiency of your data solutions: automate quality checks, monitor freshness, tune performance and compute costs, and participate in the on-call rotation to resolve incidents and prevent recurrence.

• Create reusable frameworks and development patterns that improve delivery speed and consistency. Apply automated testing, code review, and repeatable deployments; maintain technical standards, runbooks, and learning materials.

• Partner with business users and engineering teams to clarify requirements, resolve issues, and contribute to the data engineering roadmap, including platform capabilities, priorities, technical trade-offs, and delivery estimates.

• Apply AI tools to development, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting. Validate generated code and results, protect sensitive data, and assess whether these tools improve quality and reduce delivery time.

Who You’ll Work With
You’ll join the Data Engineering team, working with your manager, fellow engineers, and partners in analytics, data science, product, and business operations across Lending and Insurance. You’ll also collaborate with platform and infrastructure teams to manage dependencies, support production services, and turn business priorities into practical data solutions.
What You’ll Bring

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, including data warehousing, ETL/ELT development, and analytics, with a record of delivering and supporting production solutions.

• Advanced SQL skills, including writing, tuning, and debugging complex queries and using data analysis to investigate problems.

• Experience designing data lakes and warehouses on scalable, distributed platforms, with an understanding of batch and streaming integration patterns.

• Strong dimensional modeling skills and sound data warehousing practices, including defining grain, fact and dimension tables, and how historical changes are represented.

• Ability to deliver projects with minimal guidance in an Agile team, using testing, version control, documentation, and systematic troubleshooting to build maintainable solutions.

• Clear written, verbal, and data presentation skills, including the ability to understand business needs and explain findings and technical decisions through documentation, presentations, or dashboards.

What Will Help You Thrive
You’re curious about the business behind the data, learn new tools thoughtfully, communicate issues early, and share both credit and lessons learned. Experience in any of the following is a plus:

• Snowflake virtual warehouses, performance and cost tuning, Streams and Tasks, and/or SQL Server.

• Matillion, dbt, or similar tools for data integration and transformation.

• Python, C#, or PowerShell for integration and automation; Git/GitLab for collaboration and CI/CD workflows.

• Power BI, Tableau, or Streamlit for dashboards, data applications, and communicating insights.

title: Site Manager
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. The fleet you run will draw more power than some countries, on the way to 10s of GW.

- Fly the plane while it's being built. Sites come online in pieces, and you keep the live ones running flawlessly while construction continues around them.

- Write the playbook, don't inherit it. No prior operations org has run at this speed and scale, so the standards you set become the standard.

- Own site safety in partnership with HSE, including hazardous energy control, electrical safety, and LOTO discipline across a mixed employee and contractor workforce.

title: Algorithms Engineer, Power Applications
description:
Karman is a fast-growing NVIDIA-backed AI company enabling AI data centers to dynamically orchestrate power and unlock more compute capacity from existing energy infrastructure. For over a decade, we have applied AI to the electric grid, bringing real-time visibility and power-flow control to complex energy infrastructure. Our Karman platform, built on a custom NVIDIA module, brings that same capability to AI data centers, giving operators a way to better use the power already available to them.

The Power Applications team takes power orchestration algorithms from idea to production. We develop, ship, and maintain the applications that run on Karman to orchestrate closed-loop control actions and deliver quantifiable customer value. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role. As a Senior Algorithms Engineer, you will develop and deliver these control algorithms, working day to day with the principal engineer who owns our control architecture. You will develop the theory behind our algorithms, validate them against real hardware and realistic workloads, implement them in production code alongside our software engineers, and stay with them in the field, measuring, tuning, and improving them release after release.

Your time will be split between improving the algorithms already in production and R&D for the next iterations of the product, from smarter forecasting and online learning to orchestration across larger portions of a data center and new generations of GPU hardware.

Strong candidates come from many paths. Some lean toward control theory and estimation, others toward building and hardening real-time systems. Both are welcome. What we require is rigor, a systems mindset, and the drive to see your work shipped and owned.

Responsibilities

• Design, analyze, and deliver improvements to the control and orchestration algorithms that allocate and enforce power across servers, racks, and rows at high speed and with hard reliability guarantees

• Own algorithms end to end: theory and prototyping (Python), production implementation (Rust and Python), validation, deployment, and ongoing tuning in the field

• Help to define how we measure algorithm performance, from adherence to electrical limits to impact on compute throughput, and build the benchmark and regression suites that hold each release to that bar

• Continuously improve the performance, robustness, and operability of the algorithm-driven services already in production

• Drive R&D that de-risks and shapes future product iterations (forecasting, automated parameter tuning, orchestration at larger scales, new compute and actuation hardware), running experiments in our lab and pilot environments and turning results into clear decisions

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, physics, mechanical or aerospace engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience

• Deep expertise in control systems and mathematical optimization, including feedback control, state estimation, and the practical realities of latency, noise, and missing data, ideally in distributed or edge settings

• A track record of taking algorithms from concept to production in physical systems, owning their performance once deployed, and designing them to fit the whole system rather than optimizing components in isolation

• Strong Python skills for prototyping and analysis (e.g. pyspark, tensorflow, pytorch) and the ability to work in production codebases in a systems language (we use Rust, and will support you in learning it)

• Comfort in a continuous delivery environment: working directly in production repositories, writing tests, reviewing code, and using field performance data to understand and improve algorithms

• Excellent written communication and the habits of a strong remote teammate: proactive updates, thorough documentation, empathy, and assuming good intent

• Willingness to travel up to 10% of the t

Job Overview
As a Quantitative Researcher at hermeneutic research, you will develop and improve systematic trading strategies across digital asset markets.
You will work across the full research lifecycle: identifying market inefficiencies, developing hypotheses, analyzing large-scale market data, building predictive signals and trading models, designing robust backtests, and helping to monetise successful research and improve firm-wide execution quality.

• Research market microstructure, liquidity dynamics, price formation, execution behavior, and short-horizon alpha.

• Develop quantitative models for signal generation, execution, portfolio construction, and risk management.

• Evaluate existing strategies and identify opportunities to improve alpha, execution quality and robustness.

• Work closely with engineers to translate successful research into reliable production trading systems.

• Monitor live strategy performance and investigate discrepancies between research, simulation, and production results.

• Continuously improve research methodologies, datasets, tooling, and experimental standards across the quantitative research process.

• A degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, Finance, or another highly quantitative field.

title: Senior Fullstack Mobile Engineer
description:
ABOUT US:

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a seasoned Fullstack Mobile Engineer to help shape the core experience for thousands of restaurant teams. This is a senior role focused on building performant, polished applications across mobile platforms.

You’ll lead development of cross-platform features, collaborate closely with design and product, and contribute to shared backend components when needed. You should bring a strong product mindset, care deeply about developer experience, and be excited about building better software, faster.

This role is ideal for someone who has experience shipping real-world apps, and is looking to make high-impact technical decisions in a fast-moving team.

 

Our Tech Stack: We use Kotlin multiplatform and Jetpack Compose. Everything runs in GCP and our database it’s Postgres.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Work on the development of our app architecture across Android and iOS

- Design and implement shared business logic and client code, as well as platform-specific UI components where needed

- Work closely with designers, PMs, and other engineers to deliver intuitive, delightful product experiences

- Contribute to backend services where necessary, ensuring tight integration and performance across the stack

- Continuously improve build tooling, developer experience, and code quality

- Play a critical role in shaping how Tebi scales across new markets, languages, and user types

 

WHAT YOU BRING:

- 7+ years of experience in software engineering, with deep expertise in mobile engineering

- Strong experience building and shipping Android apps; familiarity with iOS and multiplatform development patterns.

- Strong experience with Kotlin

- Comfortable owning architecture decisions and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ship features

- A strong product mindset, you care about solving real problems for users, not just writing code

- Great communication skills and a pragmatic approach to building scalable systems

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

 

BENEFITS:

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary

- Lunch Provided in Office

- Team building events

- Unlimited time off

Note: Interviews will start after the 14th of September.

 

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

 

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

• Support specialist referrals based on clinical directives, including preparing referral documentation and required forms.

• Assign referrals to appropriate specialist clinics based on patient location, clinical need and specialty.

• Redirect referrals when clinics are unresponsive or decline them.

• Review specialist consult reports and determine whether patient follow-up is required.

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BScN).

• Strong clinical judgment and confidence reviewing lab results and specialist documentation.

• Comfort working independently in a remote, technology-enabled environment.

• Proficiency using Mac devices and learning new digital tools quickly.

• Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal.

• Bilingual proficiency in French is a significant asset, but not required.

• Strong understanding of patient privacy and confidentiality requirements.

The details

• Job type: Independent contractor with variable hours based on operational demand. Most RN contractors are expected to support 10-20 hours per week on average, depending on volume and availability.

• Hiring manager: Manager, Care Delivery Operations

• Location: Fully remote within Canada

• Start date: November 2026

• Pay rate: $35 hourly

title: Data Privacy Manager
description:
The Data Privacy Manager (“Privacy Manager”) is responsible for managing, co-ordinating and generally implementing KLDiscovery ’s data protection strategy and ensuring compliance with applicable data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”), the UK Data Protection Act 2018 and US State privacy laws including the California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”) and Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (“HIPAA”). The Privacy Manager will act as the internal lead for KLDiscovery on data privacy queries, serves as the primary point of contact for data subjects and regulatory authorities, provides expert advice on data protection matters, undertakes implementation of data privacy initiatives, ensures compliance with KLDiscovery policies and supports KLDiscovery in managing risks associated with the processing of personal data for clients and employees.

Key Responsibilities

Compliance Monitoring and Advisory

• Monitor compliance against global data protection laws and internal policies, procedures, and controls, both for clients and employees.

• Advise KLDiscovery and its employees on data protection obligations and best practices.

• Monitor emerging trends, legislative changes, and guidance relating to data privacy, particularly involving use of artificial-intelligence.

Risk and Assessment

• Conduct regular audits, risk assessments, and reviews of data processing activities including vendor due diligence as it relates Data Privacy Assessments.

• Co-ordinate and manage Data Protection Impact Assessments (“DPIAs”), Transfer Impact Assessments (“TIAs”), Legitimate Interest Assessments (‘’LIAs’’) and advise on mitigating risks for both product and internal initiatives.

Records and Documentation

• Develop and maintain data protection policies, privacy notices, and supporting documentation.

• Assist in development of contractual frameworks for clients and providing advice on best practices.

Data Subject and Regulatory Liaison

• Serve as the primary contact for data subjects regarding data protection queries, complaints, and requests, including Subject Access Requests (“SARs”), with responses managed within applicable statutory timeframes and data deletion.

• Act as the primary liaison with supervisory authorities and facilitate communication in the event of a data breach or investigation.

• Support the cybersecurity incident response process by providing expert guidance on breach classification, notification obligations, and regulatory reporting requirements across applicable jurisdictions including GDPR, HIPAA, DORA, NIS2, and US state laws.

Governance, Training and Awareness

• Deliver KLDiscovery ’s data protection training and awareness programme.

• Client and commercial support answering data privacy questions from clients as part of client RFPs and due diligence process and questionnaires.

description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

TEAM CONTEXT

The AI Transformation Office (AITO), part of AI Core, is Nubank's central office driving the company-wide AI transformation. We orchestrate all of the AI workstreams - including function transformation, infrastructure, AI risk, AI cost and communications - and work directly with Nubank's management team and senior leaders across the company.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

You join a small core team as the person who brings the outside view: first-hand experience of how an AI plays a key role at a company that is further along. You'll use it to shape where Nubank's transformation goes next, decide which AI solutions we build or buy, and structure how progress reaches the management team - while staying hands-on enough to unblock the initiatives that matter most.

Impact: you will shape the direction, reach and quality of Nubank's AI transformation.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Shape Nubank's AI strategy with industry learnings. Bring what worked and failed at top players to define where Nubank goes next - what to double down on, what to stop, how to sequence it, and which operating model fits.

- Define our AI solutions portfolio. Map the AI solutions we have internally and support build-vs-buy calls - which tools, harnesses and context layers Nubank should build in-house versus source externally - and shape the scope of the ones we build.

- Own the management team narrative. Structure what goes to Nubank's management team every week - turning signals from every workstream into a clear picture of progress, risks and the decisions needed.

- Define what success looks like. Set ambitious targets for our AI initiatives and the KPIs, measures, and mechanisms that show whether they are actually delivering impact.

- Unblock critical initiatives. When something is stuck, go into the team, understand the blocker and resolve it - across functions, without formal authority.

- Run the operating rhythm. Lead weekly workstream sessions with initiative owners on gaps, ETAs and resourcing; connect cross-workstream dependencies and escalate risks early.

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Member of Technical Staff, Data & Evals in Harvey Research, you’ll build the data and measurement systems that power our post-training, benchmarking, and agent capability efforts.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own synthetic data pipelines, evaluation design, the tasks and grading behind training environments, and the systems that turn feedback from domain experts into training signals and rewards. These are tasks where correctness often can’t be verified automatically, so defining and measuring quality is a core research challenge. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work.

We’re looking for research engineers who can build reliable data and evaluation systems, question what a metric actually tells us, and work closely with researchers and legal experts to turn model failures into measurable improvements.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research http://harvey.ai/research.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build synthetic data pipelines that generate, filter, and curate training and evaluation samples for complex legal reasoning and agentic workflows.

- Design evaluations and verifiers that reflect real legal work, calibrate them against expert judgment, and investigate where they fail.

- Build and maintain capability benchmarks like our Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB), along with product-focused evals that track how models perform on real customer workflows.

- Work with legal domain experts to define quality metrics, rubrics, and other grading mechanisms for training and evaluation.

- Own training and evaluation data quality, including provenance, coverage, and safeguards against contamination.

- Close the loop from product usage and customer feedback to new evaluations and training data, so models improve where customers need them most.

- Partner with researchers to investigate model failures, distinguish real gains from misleading metrics, and use findings to guide training and release decisions.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- Experience building data pipelines, ML evaluation systems, or experimentation tooling, with strong Python skills and ownership of production-quality code.

- A rigorous approach to measurement, including statistical reasoning, experimental design, and understanding when a metric can mislead.

- The ability to translate ambiguous goals or expert judgment into structured datasets, rubrics, and measurable criteria.

- Experience with synthetic data, LLM evaluations, automated raters, or preference data is a plus. Strong data and measurement engineering experience close to ML model development is valuable even without prior LL

title: Data/ETL Engineer (Senior)
description:
Overview
DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Data/ETL Engineer to sustain SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), develop approved integrations, and maintain reliable data pipelines supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
This position will implement raw, standardized, and curated data layers using SQL, Python, APIs, and incremental loading techniques. The engineer will reconcile data, manage schema changes, maintain lineage, and troubleshoot complex pipeline failures to support accurate and timely mission analysis, AI capabilities, and reporting.
The Senior Data/ETL Engineer will work with the Lead Data/ETL Engineer, database administrators, data governance personnel, AI/ML engineers, BI developers, testers, and Government stakeholders to maintain secure, traceable, and supportable data integrations.
This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.
Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.
Duties & Responsibilities
The Senior Data/ETL Engineer will:

• Sustain, troubleshoot, and optimize SSIS packages, configurations, schedules, and dependencies.

• Develop and maintain approved integrations between source systems, databases, APIs, analytical environments, and reporting platforms.

• Write SQL queries, stored procedures, transformations, and reconciliation routines.

• Develop Python scripts for data ingestion, processing, validation, orchestration, and operational automation.

• Implement raw, standardized, and curated data layers with documented transformation rules.

• Build and maintain incremental loads, including checkpoints and tracking of previously processed data.

• Implement API authentication, pagination, retry handling, logging, and error processing.

• Reconcile source and target data using record counts, totals, completeness checks, and business rules.

• Manage schema changes and assess their effects on pipelines, datasets, integrations, and reporting outputs.

• Maintain source-to-target mappings, identifier mappings, metadata, and data lineage.

• Implement controls for duplicate, missing, invalid, or failed records and support controlled reprocessing.

• Monitor pipeline execution, data freshness, processing performance, and operational errors.

• Investigate complex failures involving SSIS, SQL, APIs, source data, transformations, and downstream dependencies.

• Implement approved corrections and validate successful processing and reconciliation.

• Coordinate changes with database, application, governance, AI/ML, BI, and testing teams.

• Support automated regression testing, data-quality checks, defect resolution, and release validation.

• Maintain version-controlled code, deployment instructions, rollback procedures, and operational runbooks.

• Provide technical status, troubleshooting findings, risks, and improvement recommendations to the technical lead and Government stakeholders.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
The following must-have qualifications are drawn from the supplied position requirements:

• Active Secret clearance or higher.

• Minimum of eight years of relevant professional experience.

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or a permitted equivalent.

• Experience maintaining and supporting SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).

• Strong SQL and Python skills.

• Experience building or supporting API integrations.

• Experience implementing incremental data loads.

• Experience performing data reconciliation and managing schema changes.

• Experience documenting and maintaining data lineage.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Trust & Safety
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Senior Backend Engineer II in the Zen team, you will be responsible for building the systems that help keep counterfeit items off Vinted, while protecting legitimate sellers.

Zen sits in the Trust domain and owns the counterfeit detection problem end to end, not just the tools. We combine rules, machine learning and modern AI to find counterfeit listings, understand where detection falls short and keep improving it. The work has a direct impact on how safe and trustworthy Vinted is for our members, and we're growing our use of AI to make that protection work at Vinted's scale.

We work with Go, Ruby and Python, alongside ML models and LLMs.

In this position, you’ll 

• Design and build the backend services behind counterfeit detection.

• Spot new counterfeiting patterns early and turn them into new detection capabilities.

• Take technical ownership of complex projects, from idea to production, including writing RFCs and making architecture decisions.

• Build AI-driven capabilities, including LLM-based systems, that are reliable, observable and cost-aware.

• Collaborate with data and decision scientists, using data to make decisions and bringing engineering input to how detection and models are improved.

• Measure the impact of what we ship, with accuracy and fairness to legitimate sellers in mind.

• Raise the bar for engineering and agentic development by mentoring engineers in the team and beyond.

About you 

• Proven experience designing, building and operating ML- and data-driven backend systems in production, with Go, Ruby or Python, including event-driven systems.

• Curiosity and drive to explore and apply AI to counterfeit detection, staying on top of the latest developments in LLMs and their practical applications.

• Solid understanding of data, ML and LLMs: how models are trained, evaluated and retrained, and how to build reliable systems around them.

• Comfortable working with data and decision scientists, using data to make decisions and contributing valuable engineering input.

• Demonstrated ability to own complex, ambiguous problems end to end and drive technical decisions.

• Pragmatic about trade-offs between catching abuse and protecting legitimate sellers, and able to explain technical decisions to non-engineers.

• Advantage: 

• Bonus: experience with BigQuery, Vespa, Temporal

Work perks

• 25 working days of holiday

• Access to all the tools & tech nee

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

We move fast, build in public, and
